# Results

Every page in this theme is rendered from the committed benchmark artifact. Benchmark baked with engine `blastfrag` 0.03.000 and application 0.05.000, 100 draws per random protocol, 2000 site resamples per interval, seed 0, corpus digest `9a72094d641a2557`.

1. [The verdict](results/01_verdict.md), on the two row sets it depends on.
2. [Every arm](results/02_every-arm.md), under every protocol, with spreads and intervals.
3. [Protocol sensitivity](results/03_protocol-sensitivity.md), random against deduplicated against held out by site.
4. [Per site](results/04_per-site.md), the error on each campaign an arm did not see.
5. [Published reproductions](results/05_published-reproductions.md), the hold-outs, the recomputed regression and the network seeds.
6. [Diagnostics](results/06_diagnostics.md), the outlier screen and two views of importance.

How each number is defined is in [protocols](protocols.md); what each arm is, in [methods](methods.md).
